sentences.text: Researchers analyzed cross-sectional survey data collected from residents of 38 Australian retirement villages.
Approximately 24% of the older adults in this sample reported subjective memory problems.
Participants aged 85 to 89 and those 90 and older were more likely to report these issues than individuals under 75.
The reporting of memory problems was associated with being male, feeling lonely, having unaided hearing impairment, impaired vision, experiencing falls, and taking five or more medications.
